limitations: Six rounds on one M1 Mac; descriptive medians and ranges, no statistical significance claim
Startup is initialized/reused-profile, not OS-cold boot; no cache flushing
Local deterministic navigation fixture, not a general internet-speed claim
RSS sums process resident sets and may double-count shared pages; it is not unique RAM
Footprint is charged macOS process-tree footprint, including compressed/swapped pages; preserve unavailable values
CPU windows cover only stable observed processes, not complete app CPU, energy or battery life; do not compute CPU efficiency ratios
Exact private ad hoc candidate includes combined1.2.0source plus performance/storage changes; functional feature acceptance and release identity still pending
Earlier v7 setup attempt failed before scoring and remains preserved; never pool it with this v8 run
No comparative speed claim may use the PC compiler batch benchmark
cpuSummary: All36settled CPU windows unavailable because observed CPU did not exceed aggregate counter uncertainty. No comparative CPU/battery/energy claim.
chromeFootprint: Unavailable summaries:49/60native samples observed,7missing/too-recent process identities,2tree changes,2missing native identities/counters. Never pool only the observed samples.
interpretation: Candidate product-new-tab readiness and reused-profile startup are lower than Chrome, but those strengths mostly predate this update. The first local-navigation pause is lower than the installed baseline but remains higher than Chrome. Overall navigation and ten-tab RSS regress; do not imply universal gains, all-faster browsing, or lower whole-browser RAM.
